name: alladin_status
description: Read the paper portfolio, open positions, pending decision and circuit breakers from GET /v1/status. Market data and live orders come only from Coinbase.

name: alladin_command
description: Call POST /v1/commands on the authenticated Alladin backend. The only external venue is Coinbase. Never executes a shell command or accepts a wallet secret. Supply a unique idempotency key per logical request.

args.description: Arguments exactly matching GET /v1/contract; use an empty object for commands with no arguments.
